name: Boku no Seishi ga Gravure Idol Shibou Joshi no Oppai o Fukuramaseru Tokkouyaku Datta Ken
original_name: ボクの精子がグラビアアイドル志望女子のおっぱいを膨らませる特効薬だった件
source:
Rio is on track to become one of the best in the entertainment business.
She has one hurdle: her washboard chest. The answer is in... the protagonist's balls!?
His (your) semen is a miracle seed that grows little tomatoes into juicy melons.

她只有一个障碍：平坦如搓衣板的胸部。答案竟然在……主人公的睾丸里！？
他的（你的）精液是奇迹种子，能让小番茄长成汁水丰盈的大西瓜。
